verdict.rationale: The only first-party coverage figure in the evidence is that Plaid's European Payments suite reaches "18 European markets," which gives a geographic count for one product line. Nothing in the pack publishes institution counts or a country-by-country list a founder could check against where users bank. Missing for 10: published number of supported institutions, a full list of supported countries/geographies across all products, a per-institution coverage lookup, and independent corroboration of coverage claims.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform documents how many institutions it reaches and where — published coverage numbers and geographies I can check against where my users actually bank

citations.quote: Verify user accounts, manage risk, and move money across 18 European markets, all through a single Plaid integration.
